name: Steel of West Virginia Melt Shop
old_description: The Steel of West Virginia family of companies aims to provide our customers with industry leading products by maintaining focus of our ethics and standards. In fact, we have embraced Steel Dynamics, Inc.'s Six Pillars of Success to demonstrate our commitments.
about:
Steel of West Virginia operates from Huntington, West Virginia, as part of the Steel Dynamics, Inc. family of companies. The melt shop and fabrication business traces its roots to the region’s steelmaking heritage, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership rests with Steel Dynamics, a publicly traded steel producer headquartered in Fort Wayne, Indiana.

The company produces a range of steel products including merchant beams, channels, guardrail, and specialized sections for truck trailer, industrial truck, rail and track, off-highway equipment, and solar mounting structures. Its capabilities center on fabrication services, with the melt shop supplying semi-finished steel for downstream forming and finishing. Facility size, headcount, and annual tonnage are not disclosed.

Customers span transportation, construction, rail infrastructure, renewable energy, and heavy equipment sectors. Concrete examples include suppliers to truck trailer builders, industrial truck manufacturers, rail track contractors, guardrail installers, off-highway vehicle OEMs, and solar racking fabricators.

Steel of West Virginia emphasizes adherence to Steel Dynamics’ Six Pillars of Success, a framework that stresses ethical conduct, safety, and operational excellence. The company states its commitment to quality products through a focus on ethics and standards, backed by ISO 9001 certification.
